checks: Choose/review/cancel makes no draft mutation, storage write or external request
Insert keeps selected text, focuses caret, undo restores exact body, explicit save and reload keep reference
Page insertion is a separate editable entry with no private note or source mutation
Changing original collection does not rewrite inserted snapshots; hidden page entry stays out of share draft
Failed page save retains the new entry and retry; removal affects only composition
Manual reference validates source and changes no collection; composing Enter does not insert
Writing draft failure preserves inserted text; successful retry keeps backup text
Collection read failure allows retry; late read cannot open a dialog after leaving writing
